# ankra_registry_robot (Resource)

A robot account on a registry project: a docker login for CI or a cluster, scoped to push or pull. The counterpart of `ankra registry robots create`, `rotate` and `delete`.

The platform answers the robot's secret once, at creation and at each rotation, so it is kept in state and cannot be recovered on import. A robot cannot be edited in place: every setting except `rotation_triggers` replaces it. Change any value in `rotation_triggers` to rotate the secret in place: the robot keeps its name and the organisation credential holding its login, so references to `credential_name` stay valid, and only the old secret stops working.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_registry_robot" "cluster_pull" {
  name        = "cluster-pull"
  project     = ankra_registry_project.ci.name
  scope       = "pull"
  description = "Image pulls for the production cluster"

  # Change the value to rotate the secret in place.
  rotation_triggers = {
    rotated = "2026-10"
  }
}

output "docker_login" {
  value     = ankra_registry_robot.cluster_pull.docker_login
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Robot name, unique in the organisation. Changing it replaces the robot.

### Optional

- `admin_credential_name` (String) The organisation credential allowed to manage robots on `registry`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description. Changing it replaces the robot.
- `expires_in_days` (Number) Days until the registry stops honouring the robot. Unset is a robot that never expires. The platform reports only `expires_at`, so after an import this value is taken from configuration without replacing the robot.
- `permissions` (Set of String) The robot's own grants, written `resource:action` (see `ankra registry robots permissions`). Conflicts with `scope`. Grants beyond push and pull need the `credentials.reveal` permission.
- `project` (String) Registry project the robot is bound to: `default` (the organisation's own project, the default) or the name of an `ankra_registry_project`. On an integrated registry, that registry's project, and required there.
- `registry` (String) Integrated OCI registry entry (a Harbor the organisation runs itself) to mint the robot on, instead of the Ankra registry. Requires `admin_credential_name` and `project`.
- `rotation_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; changing any of them rotates the robot's secret in place.
- `scope` (String) Preset grants: `push` (push and pull) or `pull`. Conflicts with `permissions`. When neither is set the platform mints a push robot; when `permissions` is set the platform reports `custom` here.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the robot was minted. A robot of the same name minted later is a different robot: Terraform then treats this one as gone instead of adopting it.
- `credential_name` (String) Organisation credential holding the robot's login.
- `docker_login` (String, Sensitive) A `docker login` command using the secret. Null after an import.
- `expires_at` (String) When the registry stops honouring the robot; null for one that never expires.
- `host` (String) Registry host the robot logs in to.
- `id` (String) The robot name.
- `robot_name` (String) The robot's user name on the registry, used as the docker login user.
- `rotated_at` (String) When the secret was last rotated; null before the first rotation.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The robot's secret, answered once at creation and at each rotation. Null after an import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Registry robots are imported by name. The secret cannot be read back and stays null until the next rotation.
terraform import ankra_registry_robot.cluster_pull cluster-pull
```
